# Vendored xterm.js assets

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0

These prebuilt browser files are embedded in `mnc-station`; Node.js is not a
runtime dependency. The corresponding upstream MIT licenses are retained as
`LICENSE.xterm` and `LICENSE.addon-fit`.
